ChartEntry Reading/Gap owns correct observation payload, gap has no fabricated measurements. Historical capability band is pinned so later skill cannot sharpen old chart; observation cadence independent of band while precision differs. HMAC phenotype secret remains private, discriminator uses actual Meter order; this source read is not cryptographic validation or generic hash-equivalence clearance. Terminal Meter::min uses canonical order, distinct from disease vital-largest selection, never globally merge those policies.
